dedupe_keys.name: mopo industry data for switzerland norway and uk

description: Jorge Andres Moncada, Pieter Valkering and Hans Van de Put at the Flemish Institute for Technological Research publish industry data for Switzerland, Norway and the United Kingdom. The native description states that these inputs are used to create the MOPO industry technology catalogue covering EU30. Zenodo lists one XLSX workbook and provides free open access under CC BY 4.0. This record represents the country-extension input collection; the related industry technology catalogue contains processed technology tables and retains its own version identity. Underlying information may therefore overlap, and the resources are not claimed to be independent observations. Coverage is the three named countries, while sectors, variables, units, reference years and internal regional resolution are unspecified in the short source description. A limitation is the lack of field-level detail for standalone interpretation. No workbook body was downloaded and the conversion into the full catalogue was not reproduced.
